verdict.rationale: Klaviyo states it is accessible headlessly through its public APIs and MCP server, so people and agents can act on its data outside the UI. Non-interactive private API keys with scopes, maintained server-side SDKs, test accounts and rate-limit/Retry-After headers support unattended automation, including programmatic campaign and event creation. missing for 10: an official CLI, CI-specific documentation or examples (e.g., pipeline recipes), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
